title: XpressO-Lung predicts spatial gene expression from lung adenocarcinoma slides
summary: XpressO-Lung learns links between H&E whole-slide morphology and bulk transcriptomic data to predict spatial expression of genes including NAPSA, CD8A, TTF1, KEAP1 and TP53, with AUCs of 0.64-0.92 on 200 TCGA cases. Predicted spatial patterns were compared with immunohistochemistry on an external set of clinical samples at Dartmouth Health and found concordant with observed histomorphologic features.
ai_technology: Explanatory deep learning model on H&E whole-slide images (XpressO-Lung)

evidence.tested: Cross-validated prediction on 200 TCGA cases and immunohistochemistry comparison on external Dartmouth samples.
evidence.unknown: Concordance with IHC was qualitative; modest AUCs for some genes; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning infers spatial gene expression from tissue morphology.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Author affiliations and publisher full text not accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
